notes.title: Sword of Wonder now in Simplified Chinese!
notes.content: I've been working with another developer on machine translations for these games, and I've added Simplified Chinese to Sword of Wonder. I hope to get even more languages done for all of the Jill Gates series of games, and I'll try to launch my next project with the translations done early on.

notes.title: Massive Achievement Expansion
notes.content: I've added 45 new achievements so players can gauge their overall progress in the game! Grind them out and get the full experience in discovering that the real Sword of Wonder has been with you the entire time.

notes.title: Minor Patch Notes 3-21-23
notes.content:
I patched a repair for the quest "Kill Three Bandits". Please report any problems after installing the patch. To force the update to be detected by the Steam App, go into offline mode then toggle back into online mode. 

Cheers.

notes.title: Show us some love!
notes.content:
Want to help out with my game development? Leave me a review on the games! We live and die by the review and we love to hear from players whether it's to suggest something or to let us know what you liked. 

Thank you for playing, and I hope to keep producing games in the future.

notes.title: Patch Notes 3-9-2023
notes.content:
- Some quests were not properly completing and returning an error rather than sending you to the next stage of that quest when there was one. The problem seems mostly related to Steam Deck devices, but shifting the code positions seems to work as intended from some feedback I've gotten.

- A few audio bugs were fixed. 

- Please feel free to report any bugs along with a copy of the error you received in the Community Hub, and I'll try to get to it as quickly as I can.

notes.title: Superspy Steve Coming Soon
notes.content: On March 24th, Cringe Games will be releasing a finished copy of [i][b]Superspy Steve[/b][/i]. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2300730/Superspy_Steve/]Wishlist today and get your copy soon[/url]!

notes.title: Patch Notes 2-27-23
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that caused a crash in one of the 4 storyline paths near the end of the game.

- Fixed the Kingmaker achievement to register for people who spoke with the goddess before pulling the sword.

notes.title: Achievements are Live!
notes.content: After too much effort, I finally got Achievements coded and live on Steam! An update should be available as of the time of this post. I started with 11 achievements, and there may be more to come.

notes.title: Audio Overhaul and Smoother Visual Transitions
notes.content: I have went through the entire game to replace and enhance music and audio for a more immersive experience. Visual transitions between and on scenes have also been improved! Watch for a few small patch updates in March for additional scene and sound design upgrades.

notes.title: Achievements Coming Soon
notes.content: I apologize for any interruptions in your gameplay as I have had to test a few versions of the game today in order to get achievements registering. I had to adjust slightly older code and libraries to newer standards and there were a few bugs (worked in game, but wouldn't register on Steam using that code). I'm going to do a simplified build test with only the first achievement active today, and if the game breaks on you, then you should be able to reboot the game to continue without affecting your game files.

notes.title: Sound and Music Updates Coming Soon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153076/a0b6be0d26c492665580b81f0e98e05f723e4982.png[/img]

I'm working right now on sound and music to improve the overall quality of the game and make the scene transitions more interesting. I'm also going to be layering in achievements, so stay tuned for more to come.

notes.title: Update for Nov 27th bug report
notes.content: Minor update to the first failure scene which had the developer's defunct Patreon information from early development.

notes.title: Stuck? Check out the Game Guide in the Community Hub!
notes.content: We put together a basic game guide to make sure that nobody feels stuck at any point in their adventures. Click here to go to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2204030/guides/]Sword of Wonder: It's Good to be a King Game Guide[/url]!
